parameters.query: SELECT name, data FROM public.key_value_store WHERE name IN ('DOMAIN_EXPIRATION_CONFIG', 'NOTIFICATIONS_BASE_URL', 'NOTIFICATIONS_INFRA_ISSUES_TOPIC', 'NOTIFICATIONS_USER', 'NOTIFICATIONS_PASSWORD')

nodes.name: Get Domain Config
nodes.notes: Always emit an item when the table has no matching rows, so config validation reports missing keys.

nodes.name: Parse Domain Config
nodes.notes: Parse the TEXT data column with JSON.parse. Validate the complete domain list and shared ntfy settings, normalize and deduplicate domain names, and emit one item per domain. An empty domains array stops the run.

nodes.name: Loop Domains
nodes.notes: Batch size 1. Done is output 0; loop is output 1. Each domain finishes its lookup and optional notification before the next starts.

nodes.name: Fetch ICANN Data
nodes.notes: Use the existing internal Selenium/ICANN service. Non-2xx and transport errors are normalized by Analyze Domain.

nodes.name: Analyze Domain
nodes.notes: Parse the ICANN registry-expiration span, calculate floored days with a minimum of zero, and apply the existing 60/30/15 and <=10-day rules. Request and parse failures become per-domain results.

nodes.name: Send Domain ntfy
nodes.notes: Publish expiration alerts and lookup errors as JSON to NOTIFICATIONS_BASE_URL using NOTIFICATIONS_INFRA_ISSUES_TOPIC. Optional Basic auth comes from NOTIFICATIONS_USER/PASSWORD. Record 2xx success or a handled failure, then advance the loop.

nodes.name: Run Summary
nodes.notes: Execution output only; no daily success notification. partial_error means at least one lookup or ntfy send failed. Config/database failures still fail the execution.

parameters.content:
## Domain expiration + ntfy

Read `DOMAIN_EXPIRATION_CONFIG` from `public.key_value_store.data` as serialized JSON text:
`{"domains":["example.com"]}`

Shared ntfy keys: `NOTIFICATIONS_BASE_URL`, `NOTIFICATIONS_INFRA_ISSUES_TOPIC`.
Optional Basic auth: `NOTIFICATIONS_USER` + `NOTIFICATIONS_PASSWORD` (configure both or neither).

Reselect the `automation-db` PostgreSQL credential after import. All expiration alerts and lookup errors publish to the infra-issues topic. The ntfy endpoint is the base URL; topic is included in the JSON body.

Update the existing workflow or deactivate its previous copy before activating this export. Manual Test sends real notifications when a domain qualifies.

See README.md and ../../database/domain-expiration/config.example.sql.
